label: One Pairformer block
context: Explains one block of AlphaFold 3's Pairformer. Layout: top lane labelled 'pair z (N x N x 128)' shown as a small 6x6 grid on the left; bottom lane labelled 'single s (N x 384)' shown as a column of 6 small squares; both lanes are horizontal lines (blue for pair, rust for single) running left to right. Five small boxes sit along the top lane, in order: 'triangle mult. outgoing', 'triangle mult. incoming', 'triangle attention (start)', 'triangle attention (end)', 'transition'; two boxes along the bottom lane, to the right of the pair boxes: 'attention with pair bias', 'transition'. Every box has a residual path: the lane continues straight under it and the box output is added back at a small plus sign. Phase by phase a highlight dot passes through each box in order; while it is inside a box, a 6x6 grid inset shows which cells that op reads for one target cell (i,j) = (2,5): outgoing = rows 2 and 5, incoming = columns 2 and 5, attention start = row 2 strong (keys) plus row 5 faint (bias), attention end = column 5 strong plus column 2 faint, transition = only cell (2,5); the caption names the op and what it reads. Then a blue arrow drops from the pair lane into 'attention with pair bias' with caption 'z enters the single track only as an attention bias: one scalar per head per pair'; the single column flashes. Final phase: a crossed-out grey arrow from single back up to pair with caption 'nothing flows back from s to z inside the block', then a counter '1 of 48 blocks' increments and the loop restarts. Canvas is responsive: width anywhere from 340 to 900 px, height 420 px; derive every size and position from width and height, keep all text at least 11 px and fully inside the canvas, and on narrow widths stack or shrink rather than overlap. Loop forever on a cycle of 16 to 22 s with smooth easing between phases. White background. Ink #04204B for text and outlines, blue #0B4FC0 and rust #B4552F as the two accent colours, light grey #EEF1F6 for empty cells. Put a one-line phase caption at the top centre that changes with the phase. No title inside the canvas (the card has one). Plain sans-serif labels.

spec.title: One Pairformer block, step by step
spec.caption: Five triangle ops update the pair lane z, each reading different cells for the target cell (2,5). z reaches the single lane s only as an attention bias, and nothing flows back from s to z.

hand_edited: indices shifted so the highlighted cell is (2,5) counted from 1, as captioned
